column5: STRONGEST FIGMA PARITY OF THE EIGHT GAMES. All 10 component frames verified `match`: Desktop 9178-4169, Desktop Start 9178-8146, Desktop Split 9178-6080, Mid Game button actions 9178-4037, Side Bet Tab 9178-8446, Side Bet Mobile 9178-10465, Mobile 9178-9840, Pointer 9178-8439 and 9178-10677 / 9178-12508. The 3 page frames (desktop 9003-117337, tablet 9003-119356, mobile 9003-119858) pass a numeric DOM audit with 0 missing sections at 1440/768/375. ★ THEIR RECORDED `partial` REASON IS NOW PARTLY STALE - it says 'the BOARD and BET PANEL frames are not built', and a later sweep verified both as match. Two real residuals keep the family off `done`. (1) 9003-118852 is NOT BUILT: it is the rival 768 frame, and one responsive tablet layout was built on 9003-119356's shape (square 422x461 board, bottom-anchored toggle, breadcrumb 'BlackJack') because A parks the 708-wide desktop board at tablet width - so one of two titled tablet screens has no implementation, the same rival-variant situation as Mines and Dice. (2) The felt art and the rules panel both print 'Blackjack pays 3 to 2' while points-game/index.ts:2626 FLOORS every payout, so a natural on a 1-point stake returns floor(2.5)=2 - even money - worth up to ~2.4pp of extra house edge at stake 1, LARGER than the 3:2-vs-6:5 gap the frame's own copy is guarding against. ✅ PRACTICE MODE ALREADY REMOVED (a28c5b3); only an orphan tests/practiceBlackjack.test.ts remains, importing the deleted module. ★ NOTE SURRENDER IS NOT A FIGMA GAP: 9178-4037 draws exactly four actions - Hit, Stand, Split, Double - so the surrender path that is configured true, implemented on SKAI, rejected on POINTS and rendered nowhere is a rules-config defect, not a missing frame element. Same for insurance (SKAI only, in no frame). Remaining rules drift: resplit aces allowed on SKAI, forbidden on POINTS; the ADMIN rules config is decorative - neither backend reads blackjack_dealer_hits_soft17 or its siblings, so an operator can change what the player is TOLD without changing what is DEALT.
